description: Nine-panel composite EBSD figure. Rows are alloys, labelled in bold at the far left: 28Mn0Ni (a,b), 28Mn5Ni (c,d) and 15Mn5Ni (e,f); columns are heat-treatment conditions, headed HR+CR+973 K (left; a,c,e) and HR+CR+1173 K (right; b,d,f). (g,h) are the corresponding phase maps of 15Mn5Ni only. Top-left arrows mark ND (vertical) and RD (horizontal). (a,c,e) are coloured inverse-pole-figure (IPF) maps of austenite; a central stereographic colour triangle is labelled 111 at the blue apex, 100 at the red corner and 110 at the green corner. A 20 µm scale bar sits in (d) and again at the bottom over (g,h). Panels (a–f) show mixed recrystallised plus deformed austenite with dark unindexed bands: (a) is largely equiaxed, (b) has markedly coarser grains, (c) is strongly elongated/banded, (e) is dominated by black unindexed areas, and (f) is finer and recrystallised. The inset of (f) is a B2-phase-only IPF map on a black matrix with vertically elongated recovered grains. (g,h) are phase maps with legend B2 = blue and FCC = red, showing blue B2 stringers that thin markedly from 973 K to 1173 K. Together the panels argue that recrystallisation, austenite grain growth and B2 dissolution all depend on alloy composition and heat-treatment temperature.

observations.observation: A stereographic IPF colour key is printed centrally in the figure, labelled 111 at the blue apex, 100 at the red corner and 110 at the green corner.
Top-left arrows label the vertical direction ND and the horizontal direction RD.
A 20 µm scale bar is printed inside panel (d) and a second 20 µm scale bar is printed at the bottom of the figure beneath (g,h).
The phase-map legend used for (g,h) assigns blue to B2 and red to FCC (austenite).

Panel (b) (28Mn0Ni, HR+CR+1173 K) shows far larger, single-colour domains than panel (a) (same alloy, HR+CR+973 K), i.e. visible austenite grain coarsening on raising the temperature from 973 K to 1173 K.
Panel (e) (15Mn5Ni, HR+CR+973 K) is dominated by black unindexed regions with only sparse elongated coloured austenite grains, indicating a heavily deformed microstructure.

The B2 stringers resolved in phase map (g) (973 K) are clearly more numerous and thicker than the blue B2 features in (h) (1173 K), i.e. the B2 fraction decreases with increasing heat-treatment temperature.

The caption states that (a,b) are 28Mn0Ni, (c,d) 28Mn5Ni and (e,f) 15Mn5Ni, with the left column at HR+CR+973 K and the right column at HR+CR+1173 K, and that (a–f) are coloured IPF maps for the austenite phase only.
The caption states that (g,h) are phase maps of the 15Mn5Ni alloy in HR+CR+973 K and HR+CR+1173 K conditions respectively.
The caption states that the inset of (f) shows the coloured IPF map for the B2 phase alone, revealing an extended recovery of its grains.
The citing text states that the phase maps (g,h) were included to highlight the dissolution of B2 particles with increase in heat-treatment temperature.
The citing text states that the dissolution rate of finer B2 particles was higher than that of the B2 stringers.
The citing text states that at 1173 K significant austenite grain growth occurred in 28Mn0Ni but not in the B2-containing alloys, as seen in Fig. 4b,d,f.

The citing text states that the prior B2 phase grains, heavily deformed with the γ-matrix during cold rolling, were fully recovered and developed bamboo-type grain morphology, while new B2 precipitates showed single-crystal-type orientations related to adjacent γ-grains.

subfigures.description: Coloured IPF map of austenite for 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR+973 K; mixed equiaxed recrystallised grains of many colours with dark unindexed boundaries and bands. Grain size is comparatively fine.
Coloured IPF map of austenite for 28Mn0Ni in HR+CR+1173 K; dominated by very large single-colour domains, showing pronounced grain growth and only a few orientations (pink, blue, orange, green).
Coloured IPF map of austenite for 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K; strongly elongated, banded/columnar grains aligned along RD with elongated dark stringer bands.
Coloured IPF map of austenite for 28Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1173 K; relatively fine, equiaxed multi-coloured grains with prominent black stringer bands running through the field; carries the 20 µm scale bar.
Coloured IPF map of austenite for 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K; heavily black (unindexed) with only scattered elongated coloured grains, indicating a highly deformed/unresolved microstructure.
Coloured IPF map of austenite for 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1173 K; finer recrystallised coloured grains with black stringer bands; contains an inset IPF map of the B2 phase alone.
B2-phase-only coloured IPF map on a black background, showing a few vertically elongated, bamboo-like recovered B2 grains with single dominant colours.
Phase map of 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+973 K with legend B2 = blue and FCC = red; dense blue B2 stringers/particles dispersed through the red FCC matrix in a banded pattern.
Phase map of 15Mn5Ni in HR+CR+1173 K with legend B2 = blue and FCC = red; blue B2 features are markedly fewer and thinner, restricted largely to stringer bands in a predominantly red FCC matrix.

unreadable_items: The inset of (f) has no independent scale bar or colour key; only the shared IPF triangle applies, so the B2 grain size cannot be quantified from it
Individual dark bands in (a–f) are unindexed/zero-solution regions whose identity (stringer B2, κ-carbide or porosity) is not resolvable from the maps alone
No numeric grain-size, phase-fraction or recrystallisation values are printed on any panel
